task: Unified Variable and Operator Splitting (VOS) Framework for Accelerated Optimization
scientific_goal: Derive Nesterov's accelerated method and ADMM from a continuous-time dynamical system perspective, proving linear convergence using strong Lyapunov functions

required_artifacts.convergence_comparison: Plot comparing GD, Nesterov/AG, ADMM, and VOS-ODE convergence rates
required_artifacts.lyapunov_decay: Plot showing Lyapunov function decay over iterations/time
required_artifacts.objective_vs_iteration: Objective function value vs iteration for all methods
required_artifacts.parameter_sensitivity: Analysis of convergence under different condition numbers or regularization strengths
required_artifacts.method_comparison_table: Quantitative comparison table with iteration counts and final objective values

related_work.paper_002: Boyd et al. (2011) - ADMM survey and applications to Lasso
